summary: Master mobile data collection with our comprehensive KoBoToolBox training course. Gain practical skills to improve your data management and analysis.
lede: Mobile Data Collection using KoBoToolbox helps you build reliable digital workflows for capturing, validating, storing, and transmitting field information. You will work with KoBoToolbox, XLSForm, and KoboCollect to configure question logic, consent workflows, offline capture, metadata, and submission monitoring. Through hands-on practice, you will test forms on mobile devices, review incoming records, manage user roles, and prepare analysis-ready exports. You will also create practical fieldwork guidance and quality checks while exploring data minimization, access permissions, retention decisions, API-based workflows, automated exports, and AI-assisted review at an overview level.
audienceIntro: This mobile data collection course suits professionals who design, supervise, analyse, or use field survey data and need practical KoBoToolbox capability from foundation to intermediate level.
prerequisites: You need basic spreadsheet skills and familiarity with the purpose of questionnaires, indicators, or field assessments. Coding is not required for completion. The course teaches advanced concepts such as API workflows, automated exports, and AI-assisted data-quality review at conceptual and operational application levels, while XLSForm configuration, KoboCollect testing, and KoBoToolbox project setup receive hands-on practice.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
